div.head: ECf 7.1
div.ab: Si quis gregem equarum habuerit, pullum decimum reddat; qui unam solam uel duas, de singulis pullis singulos denarios.

div.ab: If anyone has a herd of mares, let him render the tenth foal; he who has only one or two, for each foal a penny.

note.seg: Vgl. über die Objekte Viard Hist. de la dîme eccl. I 154ff. Hiermit verwandt scheint Ivo Carnot. Decret. III 174, nach welchem rusticus et artifex de negotio (s. 8, 2) decimationem faciat, und Zehnt fliesse (s. 7, 4. 8, 1) von apibus, agnis, velleribus, caseis, porcellis. Bischof Bernhard von St. Davids bestätigt [1115—35] die Beschenkung einer Pfarre mit decimas de blado, foeno, pullanis, vitulis, agnis, porcellis, lana, caseo, virgulto, pasnagio, placitis; Selborn Anc. facts conc. Tithes 352. — S. Gl Pferd 4c. Westminster erhält 1/<sub>10</sub> der ‘unbroken mares’ im dortigen Walde geschenkt; Davis Reg. Agnorm. 251.

On the objects cf. Viard Hist. de la dîme eccl. I 154ff. Related to this seems Ivo of Chartres, Decret. III 174, according to which rusticus et artifex de negotio (see 8, 2) decimationem faciat, and tithe is to flow (see 7, 4. 8, 1) from apibus, agnis, velleribus, caseis, porcellis. Bishop Bernard of St Davids confirms [1115—35] the endowment of a parish with decimas de blado, foeno, pullanis, vitulis, agnis, porcellis, lana, caseo, virgulto, pasnagio, placitis; Selborne Anc. facts conc. Tithes 352. — See Gl Pferd 4c. Westminster is given 1/10 of the ‘unbroken mares’ in the forest there; Davis Reg. Agnorm. 251.
